info.title: Power System Overview
info.copy: The power chain steps down from an overhead 500kV hub to 220kV, 10kV and 380V, then feeds AI server racks through UPS and output distribution.

fallback.title: 3D rendering is unavailable in this browser
fallback.body: Enable hardware acceleration or use the latest Chrome, Edge, or Safari.

eq.d500: Overhead 500kV utility intake, protection and outgoing feeder aggregation
eq.d220: Steps 500kV down to 220kV as the campus high-voltage supply
eq.d10: Receives the 10kV output from the main transformer for protection, metering and feeders
eq.dTransformer: Steps 10kV medium voltage down to 380V three-phase low voltage
eq.dLv: Receives 380V three-phase output and handles low-voltage distribution branches
eq.dAts: Safely transfers supply between utility power and the generator
eq.dUps: Online double-conversion UPS: 380V AC → DC → 380V AC
eq.dBattery1: UPS DC energy storage that instantly supports the load during a utility outage
eq.dBattery2: Parallel UPS battery extension cabinet for longer backup runtime
eq.dGen: Backup AC source for extended outages, connected through ATS
eq.dPdu: UPS output distribution feeding the data hall busway
eq.dRack: Rack PDU powers server PSUs; internal power shelves convert to 48V DC

mode.normalProgress: 500kV utility stepped down to 380V · UPS output normal
mode.batteryProgress: Utility lost · UPS battery DC instantly supports the load
mode.startingProgress: Battery continues supporting IT load · diesel generator starting and stabilizing
mode.generatorProgress: ATS transferred · generator feeds the UPS input
mode.rechargingProgress: ATS returned to utility · UPS batteries are recharging
